What it is

Static render: Spider-Man iOS app icon - glossy black eye frame with a reflective white lens over a red webbed, diagonally-ribbed squircle, presented in a grid of grey placeholder icons.

Media

Frame-by-frame

image
Centered squircle app icon: red base with fine diagonal ribbing and white web lines radiating; the mask eye sits center as a raised black gloss shape with a white/silver lens (soft top-light gradient, specular streak); surrounding greyed placeholder icons fade out of focus. Big soft drop shadow under the eye element.

Build prompt

Rebuild this static render 1:1, pixel-faithful: a Spider-Man iOS app icon - glossy black eye frame with a reflective white lens over a red webbed, diagonally-ribbed squircle, presented in a grid of grey placeholder icons.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - every value is plain layout/typography/CSS; recreate with your own components and assets.

## Layout
Centered hero squircle icon in a grid of greyed, defocused placeholder app icons. Big soft drop shadow under the eye element; the squircle itself sits flatter.

## Content & materials
Red base with fine diagonal ribbing (low contrast) and white web lines radiating from one point behind the mask. The eye emblem: raised black gloss shape holding a white/silver lens - soft top-light gradient + one tight specular streak; the lens reads as glass, not flat white.

## Color
Hero red + black + silver-white lens; placeholders neutral grey so the hero pops by contrast.

## States
None - static render.

## Don't miss
- Gloss comes from layered gradients + one specular streak, not blur.
- Ribbing rewards zooming, never shouts.
- Web lines radiate consistently from a single point.
